featured_reviews.name: Jay Bajpai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best place for wedding receptions, birthday parties, bachelor parties, and any kind of celebration!
I recently visited this venue for a wedding reception and had a wonderful experience overall. Here are my ratings:

⭐⭐⭐⭐ Ambience

⭐⭐⭐⭐ Food

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Decorations

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Service

⭐⭐⭐ Cleanliness

Areas of Improvement

The entrance from the main road is quite dark; installing proper street lighting would help.

The road leading to the entrance is in poor condition and slightly dirty. As a venue service provider, ensuring a smooth and clean access road would enhance the guest experience.

Cleanliness can be improved, especially around the corner buffet area and near the toilet section.

Additional signage for toilets is needed to guide guests properly—there was a noticeable lack of direction.

featured_reviews.name: Anurag Rajbhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vishwakarma Garden in Malad West, Mumbai, is a popular wedding venue known for its spacious lawn that can accommodate up to 1,000 seated guests or 1,200 in a floating arrangement. It is well-suited for weddings, receptions, and other large gatherings. The venue provides basic amenities like a decor team, complimentary changing rooms for the bride and groom, and on-site catering that includes vegetarian options starting at ₹1000 per plate.

The venue charges approximately ₹5,45,000 per day for rent. It also allows outside caterers and decorators. However, the venue does not permit alcohol, late-night events, or overnight music. Parking space is limited to about 20 vehicles, and no valet service is available ￼ ￼ ￼.

Guests appreciate the affordability and convenience of the location, which is 19 minutes from Malad Railway Station. However, the limited parking and non-flexible policies around alcohol and late-night events may be drawbacks for some ￼

featured_reviews.name: Hinal Malavia
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very great dining place in malad marve they even have lawns and banquet hall for events.

The restaurant is quite good with ac seating and open seatings as well.

We had
Pink lady which was a pomogranate flavoured mocktail which was refreshing and good. It was sweet.

The mango blossom mocktail was a ice cream based mocktail with mango flavour and vanilla ice cream.

The paneer chilly with coriander was good something unique the paneer was soft with bell peppers sauted in perfect sauce.

The canton balls were good and crispy with paneer stuffed in between and deep fried it was really good.

The chura seekh kebab was crunchy and rightly tandoored. With minced veggies and tasted good.

Crispy veg cheese rolls was the best it had chopped veggies filled with cheese and deep fried highly recommended.

Paneer reshmi was yellow gravy veg with sliced fresh paneer and tasted very good.

Veg mastani had chopped veggies and red gravy based veg it was very good highly recommended

Shahi tukda had bread fried topped with rabdi and was very good.

Jalebi  was thier speciality they have huge round shaped jalebi and perfectly sweet and crunchy.

featured_reviews.name: Sameer RJ
featured_reviews.review_text: This banquet and lawn located on the Marve Road near Rathodi is a nice banquet for any important event of one's lives. featured_reviews.name: Ajay Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is located in Malad West on marve road. Today we visited this restaurant with family for dinner.

Ambience is good. Sitting is comfortable, they have indoor, as well as outdoor sitting. The staff is friendly. Parking available.

We had ordered both veg and non veg food. The starters were excellent, the presentation of all dishes was very nice.

Best I like was the  chicken kalimiri kabab, must try dish for chicken lovers.

The main course was very tasty. The Chicken Matka Masala is their special dish, should try.

In desert we ordered Jalebi and rabri, they have a Keshari Jalebi, they serve one single gaint Jalebi.

A good place to spend time with family and friends over dinner.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Rameez Deshpande
featured_reviews.review_text:
Metro Banquet Hall, located in the narrow lanes of MHADA in the Malad Malvani area, is an under-construction venue that shows potential but currently has a long way to go. While the property is still being developed, it's clear that efforts are being made to improve and upgrade various aspects. However, as of now, the lack of fully functional facilities makes it less than ideal for events, especially those that require complete amenities.

One of the positive aspects of Metro Banquet Hall is its setup for wedding events. The outdoor wedding area, designed in front of the lawn, offers a charming and spacious setting for ceremonies. This open space could be a great choice for those looking for a more natural, airy environment, but it's still in need of some finishing touches due to ongoing construction.

Unfortunately, the banquet hall suffers from a major drawback—parking. Due to the congested lanes surrounding the venue, parking can be quite challenging. Guests may find themselves struggling to find a spot, especially during peak times. Given the location and lack of designated parking facilities, this could be a significant inconvenience for anyone planning a larger event.

Overall, while the venue does offer potential, particularly for wedding setups, the lack of fully developed infrastructure, parking issues, and ongoing construction mean that it’s not yet an ideal choice for those seeking a fully functional banquet hall experience. With further development, Metro Banquet Hall could become a more attractive option in the future, but for now, it's best suited for those who can overlook the ongoing work and focus on the outdoor wedding space.
